edit_instruction: Make the weighted training ball blue while preserving its shape, texture, lighting, and background.

primitives.edit_description: change the weighted training ball from black to vivid blue

questions.question: Considering only the requested color change, which description best matches the weighted training ball's current visible color?
stages: the ball retains its original black appearance
the ball remains mostly black with an emerging blue tint
the ball shows a clearly mixed black and blue appearance
the ball appears predominantly blue with residual dark areas
the ball shows the full vivid blue appearance of the target

preserve_constraints: ball surface texture and embossed lettering
